hooks.name: Commit Message Quality Check
hooks.description: Enforces commit message conventions before any git commit is executed

action.prompt:
BEFORE executing any git commit command, verify the commit message follows the convention in `.kiro/steering/convention-change-logging.md`:

1. Format: `<type>(<scope>): <subject>` with body explaining WHY
2. Body is REQUIRED — not optional. If the commit message has no body, STOP and add one.
3. For `feat` and `fix` commits: `Refs:` line with spec folder or ticket is REQUIRED
4. Subject line: imperative mood, max 70 chars, no period
5. Atomic: one logical change per commit

If the command is `git commit -m "..."` with only a subject line, REWRITE it to include a body before executing. Ask yourself: "Could someone understand WHY this change exists from this message alone?"

If the answer is no, improve the message before committing.
